package semantic

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strconv"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	"example.com/suite/domain"
	"example.com/suite/model"
	"example.com/suite/other"
	"example.com/suite/semantic/dm"
	"example.com/suite/resolve"
	"example.com/suite/semantic/rm"
)

var (
	_ domain.Repo   = &dm.RepoMock{}
	_ domain.Multi5 = &dm.Multi5Mock{}
	_ domain.Var    = &dm.VarMock{}
	_ domain.Names  = &dm.NamesMock{}
	_ domain.Embeds = &dm.EmbedsMock{}
	_ resolve.Aliased = &rm.AliasedMock{}
	_ resolve.Consts  = &rm.ConstsMock{}
	// An embedding mock also implements the embedded interfaces.
	_ domain.Repo = &dm.EmbedsMock{}
	_ other.Base  = &dm.EmbedsMock{}
)

func TestRepo(t *testing.T) {
	m := &dm.RepoMock{
		GetFunc: func(_ context.Context, id string) (*model.User, error) { return &model.User{ID: id}, nil },
	}

	var r domain.Repo = m

	u, err := r.Get(context.Background(), "x")
	if err != nil || u.ID != "x" {
		t.Fatal(u, err)
	}

	calls := m.GetCalls()
	if len(calls) != 1 || calls[0].ID != "x" || calls[0].Ctx == nil {
		t.Fatal(calls)
	}
}

func TestNilFuncPanics(t *testing.T) {
	defer func() {
		const want = "mimic: RepoMock.Get called, but GetFunc is nil"
		if got := recover(); got != want {
			t.Fatalf("panic = %v, want %q", got, want)
		}
	}()

	(&dm.RepoMock{}).Get(context.Background(), "x")
}

func TestMulti5Variadic(t *testing.T) {
	m := &dm.Multi5Mock{
		ListFunc: func(_ context.Context, _ other.Thing, opts ...other.Alias) ([]*model.User, int, error) {
			return nil, len(opts), errors.New("e")
		},
		CloseFunc: func() {},
	}

	var d domain.Multi5 = m

	if _, n, _ := d.List(context.Background(), other.Thing{N: 1}, other.Thing{}, other.Thing{}); n != 2 {
		t.Fatal(n)
	}

	c := m.ListCalls()
	if len(c) != 1 || c[0].Filter.N != 1 || len(c[0].Opts) != 2 {
		t.Fatal(c)
	}

	d.Close()

	if len(m.CloseCalls()) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("Close was not recorded")
	}
}

func TestNamesAreSanitized(t *testing.T) {
	m := &dm.NamesMock{
		BFunc: func(n int, mock_ string, fn bool) (int, error) { return n, nil },
		AFunc: func(n int, s string) error { return nil },
	}

	var d domain.Names = m

	d.B(1, "s", true)

	c := m.BCalls()[0]
	if c.N != 1 || c.Mock != "s" || !c.Fn {
		t.Fatal(c)
	}
}

// The unexported aliases of package resolve are written as their targets, so a caller outside
// the package can use plain types.
func TestResolvedAliases(t *testing.T) {
	m := &rm.AliasedMock{
		GetFunc: func(id string) (model.User, error) { return model.User{ID: id}, nil },
		SeenFunc: func(s map[string]struct{}) bool {
			_, ok := s["a"]

			return ok
		},
	}

	var a resolve.Aliased = m

	if u, err := a.Get("x"); err != nil || u.ID != "x" {
		t.Fatal(u, err)
	}

	if !a.Seen(map[string]struct{}{"a": {}}) {
		t.Fatal("Seen did not see the key")
	}

	if c := m.SeenCalls(); len(c) != 1 || len(c[0].S) != 1 {
		t.Fatal(c)
	}
}

// Array lengths that were unexported constants are written as their values.
func TestResolvedConstants(t *testing.T) {
	m := &rm.ConstsMock{
		ArrFunc: func(a [10]int, b [4]byte) [6]string { return [6]string{} },
	}

	var c resolve.Consts = m

	c.Arr([10]int{9: 1}, [4]byte{})

	if calls := m.ArrCalls(); len(calls) != 1 || calls[0].A[9] != 1 {
		t.Fatal(calls)
	}
}

func TestConcurrentCalls(t *testing.T) {
	const goroutines, calls = 32, 500

	m := &dm.RepoMock{
		GetFunc: func(_ context.Context, id string) (*model.User, error) { return &model.User{ID: id}, nil },
	}

	var wg sync.WaitGroup

	for g := range goroutines {
		wg.Add(1)

		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()

			for i := range calls {
				id := strconv.Itoa(g*calls + i)
				if u, _ := m.Get(context.Background(), id); u.ID != id {
					t.Error("mismatch")
				}

				if i%100 == 0 {
					_ = m.GetCalls()
				}
			}
		}()
	}

	wg.Wait()

	got := m.GetCalls()
	if len(got) != goroutines*calls {
		t.Fatalf("recorded %d calls, want %d", len(got), goroutines*calls)
	}

	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(got))
	for _, c := range got {
		if seen[c.ID] {
			t.Fatalf("duplicate call %s", c.ID)
		}

		seen[c.ID] = true
	}
}

func mapSlice[T, U any](s []T, f func(T) U) []U {
	out := make([]U, 0, len(s))
	for _, v := range s {
		out = append(out, f(v))
	}

	return out
}

// TestCallsAreAnonymousStructs checks that a call record is a plain struct type, so a func
// literal over that struct infers the type arguments of a generic helper.
func TestCallsAreAnonymousStructs(t *testing.T) {
	m := &dm.RepoMock{
		GetFunc: func(context.Context, string) (*model.User, error) { return nil, nil },
	}

	_, _ = m.Get(context.Background(), "a")
	_, _ = m.Get(context.Background(), "b")

	ids := mapSlice(m.GetCalls(), func(c struct {
		Ctx context.Context
		ID  string
	}) string {
		return c.ID
	})

	if len(ids) != 2 || ids[0] != "a" || ids[1] != "b" {
		t.Fatal(ids)
	}
}
